text:
sam: FYI BrightLane hitting lots of 429s in prod for the last ~8m, starting ~1705012338. customer says spikes at top-of-minute then full-page of failures. getting Retry-After: 60 a lot.
marie: can you paste the tenant id / app id and region? Also which endpoint (chat/generate/embeddings)?
sam: tenant brightlane-123, region: eu-west-1, endpoint: /v1/generate (streaming). sample request_id: rq_0a1b2c3d; backend returning 429 with these headers.
infra-bot: auto-alert: ratecap.enforce triggered for tenant=brightlane-123, policy=per-tenant-minute, limit=120 RPM, window=60s, now=135 requests in last 60s.
alex: any client-side retry loops or cron cramming at minute boundary? This looks like top-of-minute fanout. ask customer for traffic pattern.
sam: customer says they run many concurrent jobs that align to the minute (cron + lambda bursts). they also use our node SDK default concurrency. sample curl showing headers: 
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 60
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1705012380
```
marie: ok. sounds like they need two things: immediate mitigation + longer-term changes.
alex: immediate: offer 15–30m temporary quota increase or suggest spreading across regions while they refactor. also recommend client jittered backoff and exponential retry with cap.
sam: I asked customer to enable jitter & exponential backoff in their SDK: set maxRetries=6, backoffBase=200ms, jitter=true. also asked them to reduce concurrency to 8 streams per process.
devx: note for docs: add snippet for "staggered cron + backoff" and recommended SDK settings for streaming. open a docs ticket if missing.
marie: long term: advise token-splitting per-tenant (issue: single token used by many jobs), redesign cron to shard by second offsets, or use our Dedicated plan with higher RPM guarantees.
alex: also check edge-proxy connection multiplexing (HTTP/2) — a single client can open many streams concurrently and effectively bypass client-side throttle if all requests count at same token. confirm whether requests are multiplexed through a proxy.
sam: customer says they front with an internal proxy doing HTTP/2 multiplexing. asked them to throttle at proxy or use per-request queueing.
marie: I've drafted a support ticket with proposed temporary bump + recommended remediation steps, and asked for logs (client-side request timeline + sample request_ids). ticket#SUP-8472.
alex: follow-ups: (1) infra to confirm if policy should be more granular (tokens vs tenant), (2) product to document guidance, (3) support to offer temporary bump and monitor for 1h. adding @devx to coordinate docs and @infra-bot to confirm changes.
sam: I'll share the requested logs and update ticket SUP-8472 once customer replies. thanks all :thumbsup:
